purpose: Deterministic second-level synthesis of already-generated HealthSolver model outputs. It creates descriptive threshold-position patterns, applicability, co-activation and limited concordance summaries without claiming a new calibrated clinical probability.

aggregation.threshold_position_formula: If p<=t: 0.5*(p/t); if p>t: 0.5+0.5*((p-t)/(1-t)). Range 0..1; 0.5 is the model's own frozen decision threshold.
aggregation.domain_index: Equal-weight arithmetic mean of available model threshold-position values in the domain, multiplied by 100.
aggregation.domain_index_semantics: Unitless Research Activation Index (RAI), not risk, probability, prevalence, severity or prognosis.
aggregation.separation: Mean absolute distance from threshold position 0.5, rescaled to 0..100; descriptive only.
aggregation.coverage: Applicable model count divided by configured model count in the domain.

domains.label: Cardiometabolico
domains.interpretation: Cross-model descriptive pattern spanning distinct cardiovascular/metabolic source labels. Models do not share one outcome.

domains.label: Renale
domains.interpretation: Single-model renal signal. No within-domain concordance can be inferred.

domains.label: Epatico
domains.interpretation: Single-model hepatic signal. No within-domain concordance can be inferred.

domains.label: Oncologico
domains.interpretation: Descriptive co-activation across distinct malignancy/recurrence labels; not one cancer-risk outcome.

domains.label: Utilizzo / riammissione
domains.interpretation: Single readmission model; not a general utilization probability.

domains.label: Outcome acuti / critical care
domains.interpretation: Broad acute/critical-outcome activation pattern across different cohorts, index times and target definitions. Never interpreted as one mortality probability.

concordance_groups.label: Concordanza core esito ospedaliero
concordance_groups.semantics: Compares only above/below each model's own frozen threshold. Even here, cohorts and index times differ; concordance is a model-state descriptor, not a combined mortality estimate.

hard_boundaries: Never average raw probabilities across models as if they estimated the same outcome.
Never label the Research Activation Index as probability, risk percentage, mortality probability or diagnostic confidence.
Never use an ensemble threshold as a treatment, diagnosis or triage cutoff.
A domain with one applicable model is a single-model signal, not model agreement.
Abstaining models contribute neither zero nor an imputed ensemble output.
No new patient-level outcome is learned or validated in this release.
